record.dic_text:
03325 Yitshariy {yits-haw-ree'}

源自 03324 的種族名稱; 形容詞

AV - Izharites 3, Izeharites 1; 4

以斯哈族 = "油"
1) 利未的孫子及哥轄的兒子以斯哈的後裔

03325 Yitshariy {yits-haw-ree'}

patronymically from 03324;; adj

AV - Izharites 3, Izeharites 1; 4

Izharites or Izeharites = "oil"
1) descendants of Izhar son of Kohath and grandson of Levi
